name: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
description: Low-latency audio-to-audio model optimized for real-time translation of spoken conversations, providing bidirectional translation with natural voice output and a text transcript alongside the translated audio.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate model page
sources.notes: Preview model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 input / 65,536 output token limits. Live API supported, live translation supported, thinking not supported.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Standard tier: $3.50 input or $0.0053 per minute of audio, $21.00 output or $0.0315 per minute. Only the per-token prices are recorded.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Lists gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview as a preview model with a June 2026 release date and no shutdown date announced.
